messages.author: f5fc5d56032c9f70
messages.subject: error when converting CDF
parts:
Hello!

I am a new user of aroma.affymetrix. What I am trying to do is to
profile hundreds of U133 chips. I have two questions:

1. Where can I find specific info regarding the reading, preprocessing
of CEL files of U133 type?

2. I tried to convert affymetrix' ASCII CDF into binary and got some
error:


> cdfFiles[1]
[1] "annotationData/chipTypes/HG-U133A/HG-U133A.cdf"
> convertCdf(cdfFiles[1], "annotationData/chipTypes/HG-U133A/HG-U133A_binary.cdf", verbose=T, force=T)
Reading CDF header...
Reading CDF header...done
Reading CDF QC units...
Reading CDF QC units...done
Reading CDF units...
Reading CDF units...done
Writing CDF structure...
Error in nchar(unitnamesFF) : invalid multibyte string 8527
Timing stopped at: 0.22 0 0.21

I appreciate your help to get me moving.

Best,

Sean

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] error when converting CDF
parts:
On Fri, Dec 30, 2011 at 10:18 AM, itshuang <itsh...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hello!
>
> I am a new user of aroma.affymetrix. What I am trying to do is to
> profile hundreds of U133 chips. I have two questions:
>
> 1. Where can I find specific info regarding the reading, preprocessing
> of CEL files of U133 type?

You can follow the 'Gene 1.0 ST array analysis' vignette
[http://aroma-project.org/vignettes/GeneSTArrayAnalysis] for
preprocessing your HG-U133A arrays using the RMA pipeline.

>
> 2. I tried to convert affymetrix' ASCII CDF into binary and got some
> error:
>
>
>> cdfFiles[1]
> [1] "annotationData/chipTypes/HG-U133A/HG-U133A.cdf"
>> convertCdf(cdfFiles[1], "annotationData/chipTypes/HG-U133A/HG-U133A_binary.cdf", verbose=T, force=T)
> Reading CDF header...
> Reading CDF header...done
> Reading CDF QC units...
> Reading CDF QC units...done
> Reading CDF units...
> Reading CDF units...done
> Writing CDF structure...
> Error in nchar(unitnamesFF) : invalid multibyte string 8527
> Timing stopped at: 0.22 0 0.21

Q1. What is your sessionInfo() after receiving this error?

Q2. What does the following report?

library("aroma.affymetrix");
cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType("HG-U133A");
print(cdf);
print(getFileSize(cdf));
print(getChecksum(cdf));

Also, after create the binary CDF, you want to name it 'HG-U133A.cdf'.
That is, you have to put away the ASCII CDF with the same name
somewhere else (that is no longer needed).

Cheers,

Henrik

>
> I appreciate your help to get me moving.
>
> Best,
>
> Sean

messages.author: f5fc5d56032c9f70
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] error when converting CDF
parts:
Dear Henrik,

Thanks for getting back with the useful info I need. For the CDF conversion error, I found out that it was caused by a corrupted CDF file. I tried the conversion for U133_plus_2 and U133B without any problem so I looked at the U133A file and found it is much smaller. I re-downloaded the CDF file and it worked as expected. Sorry for my mistake.

Best,

Sean
